subject: exp-info-b
title: EXP.INFO.B.------SOC.RT.
description: Chart on book p. 87 (WAM-29). EXP-INFO-B (expansion information basis) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; SOC-RT (social reality) is the partner. From the subject: PART (participation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From PART: AF-DY (affinity dynamics). From AF-DY: MTA-RT-SIGN (meta-reality significance) and MT-INFO-DB. RT-T is on a dotted line from AF-DY. From RT-T: RE-ST (restructuralism). From RE-ST: PR-TR and TF-SH (transfer shifts), with the (C) prefix, "the concept of". From TF-SH: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From T-C-IMP: VT-U-PT (vibrational universe particulars). The paragraph above the chart begins: "The time-continuum implications of a given projection are another factor related to the path classical music was to take".
